caseno: Death Ref. 1 (ctg) of 1983 with Cr1. A. 2 (ctg.) of 1983
lawyer:
Formanullah Khan, Advocate, with A.K.M. Shafiqur Rahman and Mustafa Niaz Muhammad, Advocates ----- for the appellants. 
Kazi Shafiuddin, Dy. Attorney General, with Amirul Kabir Chowdhury, Advocate ----- for the state.
parties:
Lokman Hakim and Another
Vs.
The State
full_judgment: 2. Accused appellants were defended by a State defence lawyer in the trial Court. The case for The defence is that on Shamsu Meah, son-in-law of accused appellant Lokman Hakim filed Misc. Case No. 452 of 1975 in the Court of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Sadar, South, Chittagong under section 144 Cr.P.C. against informant P.W. 1 Kabir Ahmed, member of the local Union Parishad, P.W. 2 Ali Hussain, P.W. 3 Nurul Islam, Muzaffat Ahmed and others who contested the case. P.W. 2 Ali Hussain's father Ejahar Meah and two others filed Settlement Case No. 122/66-67 in the Court of S.D.O. Sadar (South), Chittagong. The place of occurrence is surrounded by hills and forests. No local witness saw the occurrence. Unknown assailants murdered the deceased. It may be that the Shanti Bahini men who sometimes used to raid that area might have killed the deceased. Out of previous enmity and as the accused persons canvassed against the informant P.W. 1 Kabir Ahmed member in the Union Parishad Election, informant P.W. 1 Kabir Ahmed in collusion with the witnesses implicated accused Lokman Hakim and his two sons Nazir Hossain and Nurul Islam in this case falsely. It is also the case for the defence that since accused appellant Lokman Hakim was aged about 95 years at the time of occurrence and used to admittedly suffer from asthma, as accused Nazir Hossain was a minor aged only about 10/12 years at the time of occurrence and as late accused Nurul Islam used to suffer from epilepsy, it was not at all possible for them to commit the murder of deceased Abdus Sobhan in any manner.
